description.value: Not humans gone small and feral — actual rat descendants, bred fast and mutated faster across two centuries in the flooded subways and sewer runoff under every city that still thinks it's standing. The surface remembers what it lost; a warren never had anything to lose in the first place. The Understreet's hideout sits inside a dead drainage vault under the Slums and still doesn't know where its own tunnels end. The nearest warren does, and charges for the map.

cinderfall.note: Note: revives and reworks the cut "Warren-folk" draft from the original 15-option list, built with a niche distinct from Ashwalkers rather than as a reskin. Added 2026-08-21 as the 11th ancestry.
inferred: bodyParts / bodyWhole / inlays counts are a generic humanoid baseline, identical on all 11 ancestries. ancestries.html states no body-part or slot count for any ancestry, so the numbers came from the conversion, not the page. The slot TERMS are authored (the Nine Slots on bio-/cyber-augmentation.html); the per-ancestry COUNTS still need a GM ruling.

unmappedBodyParts: pre-schema keys with no Nine Slots equivalent. Kept verbatim and deliberately NOT counted as slots -- the pages name no head or torso slot, and inventing one would be a design call, not a conversion.
